network_operator: SP Energy Networks (inferred from FoI reference to 'Scottish Power connections timescales')
evidence_basis: UK Government FoI response quoted by APRS: 'DV4 will be driven by Scottish Power connections timescales which we expect to be brought forward to 2027.' Zone-level developer material additionally claims 1GW+ of private-wire renewable generation (800MW wind, 400MW+ solar, 2,400MWh BESS) rather than reliance on grid import.
notes: No connection application, offer or capacity figure has been published for DV4 itself. The private-wire renewables claim is a zone-level developer claim; APRS disputes its deliverability (land take c.100 km2, energy shortfall).
